title: Return and Refund Policy
content: Customers can return items within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. Items marked as clearance or personalized are non-refundable.

title: Shipping Rates and Delivery Timelines
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs $5.99 (free on orders over $50). Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $15.00. International shipping delivery times range from 7 to 14 days.

title: Account Security and Passwords
content: Passwords must contain at least 8 characters, including one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) can be enabled under Account Settings.
